material_fixes.title: Preserve actionable capacity-rejection recovery
material_fixes.reproduction: At 100 turns, submit another question; or after 20 archives, invoke Restart. The server returns 409 with an explicit restart/new-session instruction. The UI discards that reason, presents only 'Reload the conversation before continuing', and disables Restart. Reload and retry repeats the same failure.
material_fixes.evidence: Executed production JS with a noncommitting 409: uncertain=true, restart disabled, generic status, repeated reload/send returns to the same lock. Server branches provide the concrete cap conditions.
material_fixes.fix: Distinguish known non-mutating capacity rejections from uncertain/conflicting writes, preserve the actionable reason and draft, and provide the instructed recovery. Add executed UI regressions for both limits.

material_fixes.title: Provide recovery after the initial settings read fails
material_fixes.reproduction: Fail the first /ui/assistant/settings fetch, then restore connectivity. The catch is empty and Help starts hidden, so there is no visible error, retry control, or subsequent automatic settings read; the enabled feature remains inaccessible until a full document reload.
material_fixes.evidence: Executed production-JS initial-load failure probe returned helpHidden=true, paneHidden=true, empty status.
material_fixes.fix: Expose a bounded initialization retry or recoverable error/entry point while respecting confirmed disabled configurations. Add a failed-first-settings/successful-retry regression.

material_fixes.title: Do not submit when Enter confirms IME composition
material_fixes.reproduction: Enter a question using Chinese/Japanese/Korean IME and press Enter to confirm the current candidate. The handler ignores event.isComposing, prevents the composition confirmation, sends the unfinished text, clears the draft and locks the composer.
material_fixes.evidence: Executed the production handler with key=Enter and isComposing=true: one message request was created and the draft was cleared.
material_fixes.fix: Guard composition confirmation before Enter submission and add an executed regression proving composing Enter creates no request and preserves the draft.
